# TeacherWriter

> > TeacherWriter inspires writing teachers with research-based strategies, daily prompts, and practical resources for upper elementary classrooms.

Created by TeacherWriter LLC, this site provides evidence-based writing instruction methods including the CUPS editing strategy, daily writing habit frameworks, and connections to the Science of Reading. Resources include digital journals, seasonal writing prompts, and tools for integrating writing across STEM, STEAM, and PBL curricula.

## Key Topics

- CUPS editing strategy
- Daily writing habits
- Upper elementary writing instruction
- Science of Reading connections
- Explicit genre instruction
- Metacognition and critical thinking
- Writing prompts and journals
- Cross-curriculum writing integration
- STEM/STEAM/PBL writing
- Teachers Pay Teachers (TPT)
- Evidence-based teaching strategies
- Classroom management
- Teacher resources and tools

## Core Writing Instruction

- [How to Create a Daily Writing Habit in Your Classroom and See Exponential Growth](https://teacherwriter.co/how-to-create-a-daily-writing-habit-in-your-classroom): Habit loop framework for establishing daily writing routines
- [Explicit Instruction to Teach Writing Genres in Upper Elementary](https://teacherwriter.co/explicit-instruction-of-writing-genres): Explicit instruction guide for teaching writing genres in upper elementary
- [Teach students to edit their own writing or peer edit with CUPS](https://teacherwriter.co/teach-editing): CUPS editing strategy guide for upper elementary self and peer editing
- [Develop critical thinking and metacognition with writing lessons](https://teacherwriter.co/why-writing-is-important): Why writing develops critical thinking across all curriculum areas
- [Connections With Writing Strategies and the Science of Reading](https://teacherwriter.co/science-of-reading-and-writing): Connecting science of reading with writing strategies for literacy skills

## Writing Prompts and Seasonal Resources

- [Journal Entry Starters and Writing Prompts to Unlock Creativity](https://teacherwriter.co/journal-entry-starters): 50 creative journal entry starters for elementary student writing
- [32 September Writing Prompts to Ring in the New School Year](https://teacherwriter.co/32-september-writing-prompts-to-ring-in-the-new-school-year): 32 daily September writing prompts for back-to-school energy
- [32 Daily Writing Prompts for November To Celebrate National Days](https://teacherwriter.co/national-days-in-november-writing-prompts): 32 November writing prompts celebrating national days and heritage months

## Teaching Strategies and Classroom Management

- [Teacher Tips from the Experts That You Probably Never Learned in School](https://teacherwriter.co/teacher-tips-from-the-experts): Expert classroom management and relationship tips for new teachers
- [Research on Handwriting and Learning, Evidence-Based Teaching](https://teacherwriter.co/research-about-handwriting-and-learning): Evidence-based research on handwriting vs typing and learning retention
- [The Simple Trick to Solving Word Analogies](https://teacherwriter.co/analogy): Simple trick for teaching word analogies with graphic organizer
- [Difference between a curriculum map and a year at a glance doc](https://teacherwriter.co/curriculum-mapping-or-year-at-a-glance): Curriculum mapping vs year-at-a-glance planning guide for teachers
- [Games for Learning with Google Sheets and Easy Escape Rooms](https://teacherwriter.co/games-for-learning): Google Sheets games and escape rooms for classroom gamification

## Teacher Tools and Resources

- [TeacherWriter blog inspiring writing teachers](https://teacherwriter.co/blog): Main blog hub for writing strategies and teaching resources
- [Report Card Comment Generator Writes Genuine Comments Fast](https://teacherwriter.co/report-card-comments): Report card comment generator tool for fast, genuine teacher comments
- [How to Be A Brilliant Teacher Author Seller](https://teacherwriter.co/how-to-be-a-brillant-teacher-author): Teresa Kwant interview on selling teacher resources on TPT
